title: Anvil Tick
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A single metallic percussion hit sculpted from an FM core with a sharp pitch-envelope knock, ringing in the mid register. Over 16 cycles the FM index, harmonicity steps and a resonant band-pass sweep travel on separate clocks so the strike slowly turns from a clean tick into a clanging anvil and back.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
stack(
  note("<c4 ~ c4 [~ c4]>*2").s("square")
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(3, 13)).fmh("<2.41 3.17 5.13 1.71>/4")
    .penv("<28 22 34 18>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay("<0.04 0.06 0.03>/8")
    .attack(0.001).decay(0.11).sustain(0).release(0.05)
    .bpf(sine.slow(24).range(900, 5200)).resonance(sine.slow(11).range(9, 19)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(4).lpattack(0.002).lpdecay(0.08)
    .crush("<16 12 8 10>/16").shape(0.32)
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.3, 0.7))
    .sometimesBy(0.18, x => x.speed(1.5))
    .off(0.02, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.3))
    .delay("0.3:0.1875:0.55").room(0.28).orbit(2)
    .gain(0.95)
)
